Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. As promised, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) tailored to Financely's rollout goals. I pulled together a concise post-signature implementation plan that we can embed in the MAP and use as our working checklist. High level:

- Week 0 (kickoff, days 0–3): access provisioning, kickoff meeting, success criteria alignment.
- Week 1–2 (prep & infra): environment verification, test dataset transfer, SOC2/controls handoff.
- Week 3–4 (canary): 2-week canary at 5–10% traffic with daily metrics review (latency P95, error rate, QPS, cost delta).
- Week 5–6 (migration): staged cutover, rollback gates, runbook execution.
- Week 7 (training & enablement): two 90-minute sessions + on-demand recording and Runbook/Roles doc.

Attachments included: MAP-Financely-v1.xlsx (MAP grid + owner matrix), runbook-canary.md (technical canary steps), SOC2-summary.pdf (controls summary).

Once we have signatures I’ll publish the MAP v1.1 with explicit migration windows and a DocuSign link.

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks — updated plan below addresses your asks. I’ve also attached MAP-Financely-v1.1 which includes the extended canary window and the explicit rollback gates. Quick summary:

Updated timeline (embedded in MAP v1.1):
- Week 0 (Days 0–3): Kickoff, credential exchange (Samir to confirm), success criteria sign-off.
- Week 1–2: Prep & verify test harness, transfer masked test data, install monitoring hooks.
- Week 3–4 (Canary — 2 weeks): Start at 5% traffic for first 48 hours, if stable increase to 10% for remainder. Daily checks: P95 latency, error rate (5xx), end-to-end transaction failure rate, token-cost delta.
- Week 5 (Staged Migration): 25% → 50% → 100% by feature flag increments with 1 business-day observation between steps.
- Week 6 (Cutover window & hypercare): Final cutover, 72-hour hypercare, rollback window available until 48 hours post-cutover.
- Week 7 (Training): Two 90-min sessions (recommended days: May 18 and May 19) + recording and runbook.

Rollback gates (examples included in runbook-canary.md):
- If P95 latency increases > 75% over baseline for 2 consecutive checks → ROLLBACK.
- If error rate (5xx) > 0.5% sustained for 30 minutes → ROLLBACK.
- If key transaction failure (payment or auth) observed → immediate rollback and incident bridge.

Operational items for Samir: credential list (S3/DB read-only test creds), allowlist Redwood egress IPs, and add our Datadog monitor dashboards (I’ll share runbook links).

Attachments: MAP-Financely-v1.1.xlsx (updated timelines/responsibilities), runbook-canary.md (detailed gates and monitoring checks), SOC2-summary.pdf (controls checklist). Also publishing DocuSign link once you confirm the kickoff date so we can lock timelines.

Proposed next steps:
1) Samir to confirm access by May 7.
2) Financely legal to sign DocuSign (I’ll send link once you confirm kickoff).
3) Kickoff meeting May 11 (afternoon PT) — confirm availability.

If that looks good I’ll go ahead and publish the MAP in HubSpot and send the DocuSign.

Best,
